entries.summary: Cam Thanh is Hội An’s water-coconut neighborhood, where palm-fringed lanes, coconut groves, basket-boat life, and village water shift the day.
entries.context: Cam Thanh is the water-coconut side of Hội An, where village lanes lead toward palms, channels, and basket-boat life instead of yellow-wall streets.
entries.tip: Cẩm Thanh is the name to listen for. It points toward water-coconut groves, basket boats, and the village side of Hội An.
entries.rationale: Cam Thanh brings a neighborhood rhythm built from palms, waterways, lanes, village life, and the basket-boat setting around it.

sections.title: Water-Coconut Hội An
sections.body: Cam Thanh is the neighborhood name behind Hội An’s coconut-waterway image: palms, village lanes, basket-boat routes, and green edges.

sections.title: Palm Lanes Beyond The Core
sections.body: Expect palm-fringed lanes near water coconut groves, especially away from the dense old streets. The area feels tied to water more than storefronts.

sections.title: Cẩm Thanh By Coconut Waterways
sections.body: Say Cẩm Thanh for Cam Thanh. the name helps if coconut groves, basket boats, or village routes come up in directions.

sections.title: Green Edges Shape The Day
sections.body: Cam Thanh fits a day that needs shade, water, and a slower village edge. It is not the same reset as the beach.

sections.title: Basket Boats Live Here
sections.body: Many visitors know the round boats first, but Cam Thanh is the wider neighborhood setting around that coconut-waterway experience.

sections.title: Different From A Beach Break
sections.body: Cam Thanh brings water and palms without becoming a beach stop. Channels, groves, lanes, and village routes shape it.

entries.rationale: Cam Thanh basket boat brings a specific water experience: round boat, palm channel, boarding moment, and slower movement through coconut groves.

sections.title: Round Boat, Narrow Water
sections.body: Cam Thanh basket boat is a specific Hội An water moment: a round boat moving through coconut-palm channels, not just transport from one bank to another.

sections.title: The Ride Is The Place
sections.body: Expect the boat shape, palm shade, narrow water, and boarding point to be the experience. The movement matters more than distance.

sections.title: Thuyền Thúng Is The Round Boat

sections.title: Motion Can Be Part Of It

sections.title: Coconut Channels Set The Ride
sections.body: Weather and pickup shape the ride, but the durable memory is simple: round boat, narrow water, palm shade, and the Cam Thanh coconut-channel setting.

sections.title: Cam Thanh Sets The Scene
sections.body: The basket boat makes most sense inside Cam Thanh’s water-coconut landscape. Without that setting, it becomes only a novelty shape.

entries.summary: Cantonese Assembly Hall makes Hội An’s trading history physical through a colorful Chinese hall gate, tiled roof, courtyards, stone paths, and ceremonial space.
entries.context: The Cantonese Assembly Hall keeps Hội An's trading-port past visible through community architecture: gate, courtyard, tiled roof, and ceremonial space held inside the old town.
entries.tip: Hội quán Quảng Đông is the name to listen for. Hội quán points to an assembly hall, and Quảng Đông means Cantonese.
entries.rationale: Cantonese Assembly Hall brings a built-memory stop: gate, courtyard, tiled roof, stone path, and the Chinese community layer of the old town.

sections.title: History You Can Stand Inside
sections.body: Cantonese Assembly Hall makes history physical: a colorful gate, tiled roof, courtyards, stone paths, and ceremonial space inside the old town.

sections.title: Gate, Courtyard, Roof
sections.body: Expect a Chinese assembly hall setting with lanterns, tiled rooflines, old walls, and spaces that slow you down before the next street.

sections.title: Hội Quán Marks The Hall
sections.body: Say Hội quán Quảng Đông for Cantonese Assembly Hall. Hội quán points to an assembly hall, and Quảng Đông means Cantonese.

sections.title: A Threshold Before The Courtyard
sections.body: The hall rewards a slower entrance. Notice the gate and roof first, then let the courtyard and ceremonial space set the pace.

sections.title: Short Visit, Real Detail
sections.body: You do not need to stretch the stop. A brief visit can still hold detail if you look at gates, stone paths, roofs, and altar space.

sections.title: One Of The Old-Town Halls
sections.body: The assembly hall name separates this stop from houses, temples, shops, and other heritage interiors in the Ancient Town.

entries.summary: Cao lau is the Hội An noodle bowl to know: thick chewy noodles, pork, greens, herbs, crisp crackers, and just enough sauce to coat it.
entries.context: Cao lầu is one of Hội An's clearest food signatures, tied to the town by thick noodles, herbs, pork, crackers, and a dry-sauced bowl that does not travel as easily as a label.
entries.tip: Cao lầu is the phrase to say for the dish. You do not need to add Hội An every time because the association is already strong.
entries.rationale: Cao lau carries a food memory that is specific, easy to picture, and clearly different from pho or bun.

sections.title: Hội An In One Bowl
sections.body: Cao lau tastes like Hội An specifically: thick chewy noodles, pork, herbs, greens, crisp crackers, and a dry sauce instead of a big broth.

sections.title: Chewy, Dry, Herb-Heavy
sections.body: Expect a compact bowl with texture doing the work: chewy noodles, fresh herbs, savory pork, crunchy pieces, and sauce that clings.

sections.title: Cao Lầu Is The Bowl
sections.body: Say Cao lầu for cao lau. The phrase is short enough to use on menus, at counters, or when asking what another table ordered.

sections.title: Lunch Between Walks
sections.body: Cao lau fits well between old-town walks because it feels filling without becoming a long meal. It is a bowl to sit with, not rush past.

sections.title: Not A Soup Bowl
sections.body: Cao lau usually has very little broth. If you expect soup, the dry-sauced texture can surprise you.

sections.title: Tone Marks Help
sections.body: Menus may spell it with tone marks as Cao lầu. Recognizing the words helps even when restaurant names shift.

sections.title: A Meal With River Edges

sections.title: Dinner With Less Guesswork

sections.title: Terrace First, Menu Second

sections.title: Old Town Meal, Not A Tour
sections.body: Cargo Club makes most sense as a meal woven into the Ancient Town evening, not as a standalone sightseeing stop.
